assertions.text: The plan checks the leftover worktree with `git -C /repo/.claude/worktrees/ledger-outcomes status --porcelain` (with or without --ignored)
No command in the plan changes directory into the leftover worktree (no `cd` to it, alone or chained with &&)
The leftover worktree and its uncommitted change are flagged to the user, and no command modifies, unlocks or removes the worktree
Step 6 tells the user to run /git-cleanup themselves and never invokes it
